title: Dev Autopilot agent executor: bound resent history to fix silent DeepSeek empty-completion failures

investigation.trigger: Platform owner: "Every attempt to build something with Operator failed. Are you aware of that???????"
investigation.source: dev_autopilot_executions / dev_autopilot_outcomes / oasis_events (Supabase MCP execute_sql, read-only)
failure_reasons_observed: agent hit the N-turn cap without calling finish
model answered with text N times in a row without calling finish

representative_execution.failure_signature: three consecutive dev_autopilot.agent.llm steps with message "text (0 chars)"

root_cause: agent-loop.ts's runAgentLoop() resent the full, unboundedly growing conversation history on every turn; DeepSeek's visible output shares its max_tokens budget with internal reasoning tokens, so once resent context is large enough the model's reasoning alone can exhaust the budget before any visible content/tool_calls are produced, yielding an HTTP 200 empty completion the loop cannot distinguish from the model choosing text over a tool call.

fix.mechanism: trims the OLDEST tool results to a short notice, one at a time, until under budget or only the most recent message remains; never mutates the caller's stored history, only the copy sent to callLlm

live_verification: not performed — the next real signal is a long-running staging agent-executor run completing or failing for a genuinely different reason instead of the empty-completion pattern
